name: Api → Wizard Input Is Set
description: This [Condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) checks if a Home Assistant entity has been picked for a standalone [wizard](https://esphome.io/components/api#wizard) input. Home Assistant sends the picked entity each time it connects, so after a restart this condition is false until Home Assistant has connected. It only works with standalone inputs (declared with `id`). A linked input is read through its `homeassistant` entity.
